data.name: Strangeland - The Last Colony
data.detailed_description:
A new space race brought great development to Earth. Much technology was developed using Clean Energy. The use of Helium 3 extracted from the moon brought great achievements to the planet, decades of evolution and, most importantly, saved the Earth from global warming. However, the same Helium 3 that saved the planet, ended the human race. Helium 3, abundant in the Earth's atmosphere, together with the incidence of Ultra Violet rays coming from the sun, generated an unexpected reaction, creating Dihelium Trioxide, highly toxic to human beings. More than 90% of the Earth's population died, and most of those who did not die became soulless creatures, killer zombies. The few survivors isolated themselves in a rocky canyon, with dead vegetation, contaminated soil and water, a place called Strangeland.

The only way out for the survivors is to find a secret military base, hidden in the rocky canyon, interconnected by underground tunnels, known as The Last Colony, where, according to rumors from survivors, there is a ship ready to take them back to where the whole tragedy began, a Chinese space colony, on the Moon.

Strangeland – The Last Colony is a Roguelite Sci-Fi and Horror FPS, where you take on the role of Father, an ex-military man and ex-astronaut who has done and will do anything to survive. Set in a devastated land, full of dangers and monsters that will do anything to prevent you from escaping the terror experienced on earth.

Developed by Endless Game Dev.
